text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ بَشَرًۭا رَّسُولًۭا

baseline.text: İnsanlara doğru yol geldiğinde onları inanmaktan alıkoyan tek şey, 'Allah bir insanı elçi olarak mı gönderdi?' demeleriydi.

findings.text: Rehberliğin taşıyıcısının görünür insan bedeni olması, önceden benimsenmiş elçi modeline uymadığı için içeriğin önüne geçen bir ortam yanılgısına dönüşür.

activation_trace.role: The branch's barrier between a person and a wanted act makes منع the interposed rule that stops assent.
Arrival and obtaining establish that the guidance is already present before the refusal operates.
Gentle indication toward road and truth identifies what arrived as usable direction rather than an unavailable proof.
The branch of قول as belief or doctrine lets the utterance function as an adopted criterion, not merely a passing sound.
Heart-settled confirmation names the act blocked when the recipients refuse to trust the mode of delivery.

changed_reading.after: People made their own doctrine of admissible divine mediation into the barrier to belief even after guidance had arrived.
changed_reading.before: People did not believe because they found a human messenger surprising.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exceptive construction links منع at word 2 to the people's قول at word 11 after guidance has already come at words 7-8.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance reaches the people, but their adopted proposition that divine sending and a human carrier are incompatible is installed as the barrier to settled assent. The verse locates the operative obstruction in a rule voiced by the recipients, not in absent guidance.

activation_trace.role: The visible human collective, contrasted with what is hidden or nonhuman, supplies the audience that applies the category test.
Visible skin and surface make بشر the exterior feature on which the objection fixes.
The ordinary human classification supplies the category that the audience treats as disqualifying.
Sending and directing a delegate supplies the commissioning relation that the surface judgment ignores.
A messenger as carrier of a message locates significance in the carried communication rather than the carrier's skin.

changed_reading.after: The objection is a surface-based epistemic error: visible humanity is allowed to cancel the invisible commissioning and carried message.
changed_reading.before: The objection is simply that a prophet belongs to the human species.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The human collective at word 3 objects specifically to the joined classification بشرًا رسولًا at words 14-15.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visibly human audience treats the messenger's visible human surface as evidence against his message-bearing office. The objection confuses the carrier's exterior category with the origin and function of what he carries.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch toward a need supplies the focus verse's ordinary commissioning sense.
Stirring the still from rest activates a rise-from-ordinary-state dimension in the earlier divine بعث.
Station and standing in a place give the awakening a resulting office or position.

changed_reading.after: God can stir an ordinary human into a commissioned standing, and the objection resists that transformation of familiar embodiment into office.
changed_reading.before: God sends a human who is already simply a messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier ب ع ث stirs a resting person toward a praised station, while the focus uses the same root for the disputed commission. Sending a human can therefore be heard as divine activation of ordinary embodiment into an office, not only transport of an already constituted envoy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated ب ع ث, stirring, dispatch, and station; I infer a movement from ordinary repose into commissioned standing. A narrower live alternative is that the earlier use means only elevation and contributes no vocational arrow.
structural_cues: 17:79 precedes the focus and joins ب ع ث to a praised station; 17:94 repeats ب ع ث in the questioned commission.

activation_trace.role: The focus's arrival supplies the event whose pressure on the prior arrangement is being tested.
The repeated arrival introduces the nearby sequence in which truth becomes present.
Stable correspondence to reality identifies the arriving term as what can displace unstable claims.
Going away until no trace remains supplies the removal effect that follows the arrival.
Loss of truth and stability names the arrangement exposed to disappearance.

changed_reading.after: Guidance arrived as a reality-displacing presence, and the objection to its human carrier can function as protection of what that arrival destabilizes.
changed_reading.before: Guidance merely became available and was declined.

context_deltas.mechanism: A nearby arrival pattern pairs the coming of what is real with the disappearance of what lacks stability. The focus arrival of guidance is therefore not neutral information entering an empty field; it presses against an existing false arrangement, making the human-messenger objection a defensive response to displacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an arrival-then-vanishing sequence; I transfer its displacement pressure to the focus arrival. The live alternative is simple rhetorical contrast without a causal relation between coming and vanishing.
structural_cues: 17:81 orders coming truth before vanishing falsehood; 17:94 repeats the coming construction for guidance before reporting the objection.

activation_trace.role: The interposed barrier remains the focus anchor but is relocated into the recipient's operative posture.
Healing and recovery supply one possible effect of the same revealed input.
General diminution supplies the contrary effect produced in a differently disposed recipient.
Turning one's side away gives the refusal a bodily orientation rather than a merely abstract doubt.
A formed way or direction supplies the configuration through which each recipient acts.

changed_reading.after: A formed posture turns the already arrived guidance into resistance, and the voiced proposition expresses that receiver-side configuration.
changed_reading.before: A proposition about a human messenger externally blocks belief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same revealed material is healing in one reception and loss in another; the human can bodily turn away, and action follows an acquired direction or shape. منع in the focus thus reads less like an external wall and more like a receiver configuration that converts arrived guidance into a reason for refusal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies differential effects, turning, and patterned action; I infer that disposition mediates the effect of guidance and becomes the barrier. A live alternative is that these verses describe correlated conduct without specifying the causal direction.
structural_cues: 17:82 bifurcates the effect of the Quran, 17:83 depicts a bodily turn away, and 17:84 connects action to each agent's شاكلة.

activation_trace.role: A gently sent gift to one held in regard recasts guidance as bestowed delivery rather than demanded spectacle.
Littleness and paucity bound the recipients' epistemic position from which they judge the messenger's form.
Knowledge cast in hidden fashion supplies a mode of transmission not exhausted by visible inspection.
Merciful tenderness explains the preservation of what could have been withdrawn.
Gracious giving frames the retained revelation as benefaction rather than entitlement.

changed_reading.after: Limited recipients reject a merciful gift because they presume authority to prescribe the gift's visible delivery form.
changed_reading.before: The people reject an inadequately impressive messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: Limited human knowledge stands beside revelation that can be removed and remains through mercy and gift. Activating the gift branch of هدى makes the focus objection an inversion: recipients with little knowledge judge the delivery conditions of a revocable divine gift as though the gift were owed in a form they control.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies epistemic paucity, hidden transmission, possible removal, and gift; I infer that the demand for a preferred carrier overreaches the recipient's standing. The live alternative is that these cues concern only the messenger's revelation and do not qualify the objectors' judgment.
structural_cues: 17:85 marks knowledge as little; 17:86 makes revelation removable; 17:87 attributes its retention to mercy and great favor.

activation_trace.role: قول as adopted belief makes the final question a governing criterion that can perpetuate refusal.
Turning material from form to form supplies the prior abundance and variation of presented examples.
Refusal and abstention identify the response that survives the variation.
Covering the truth names the result of persistent refusal despite varied presentation.
Settled confirmation is explicitly withheld until the first demanded spectacle occurs.
The same assent is withheld again under a later condition, showing that the threshold moves.
Ordered letters and a written object supply the final requested proof form in the escalating sequence.

changed_reading.after: Their question is the compressed form of a refusal practice in which speech continually creates a new precondition for belief.
changed_reading.before: Their question states the single reason that available evidence did not persuade them.

context_deltas.mechanism: After examples have been repeatedly varied, refusal persists and belief is twice postponed by until-conditions, ending with a demand for a readable physical writing. The focus's أن قالوا condenses this sequence: speech does not report an evidentiary deficit but repeatedly manufactures the next threshold that keeps assent deferred.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated conditional withholding after varied examples; I infer a moving evidentiary threshold enacted through speech. Sincere cumulative testing remains possible, but the repeated replacement of one condition by another makes it less explanatory.
structural_cues: 17:89 says examples were varied yet refusal remained; 17:90 and 17:93 repeat لن نؤمن with حتى before 17:94 locates prevention in what they said.

activation_trace.role: The messenger's own ordinary-human classification first marks creaturely limit without canceling his office.
Message-bearing office remains joined to humanity in the messenger's self-description.
The people repeat the same human classification but convert limit into disqualification.
The repeated messenger office exposes the dispute as a change of valuation, not a change of category.
Angels and an angelic envoy supply the alternative population-medium pair in the counterfactual.
Walking and bodily movement define the inhabitants' lived mode to which a messenger is matched.
Settled ease makes the counterfactual about a stable resident population, not a momentary angelic appearance.
The angel messenger confirms that the carrier class tracks the recipient class while message-bearing function stays constant.

changed_reading.after: Being human is the messenger's recipient-matched accessibility; the people turn the very feature enabling ordinary human encounter into a defect.
changed_reading.before: Being human is the messenger's suspicious deficiency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger first names himself as only a human messenger; the people immediately revoice the same pair as an impossibility. The following counterfactual matches an angel messenger to angels walking settled on earth. Together these cues reverse the objection: humanity is the medium's fitness for human recipients, while an angelic carrier would fit an angelic population.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact revoicing and a species-matched counterfactual; I infer a medium-recipient congruence principle. A live alternative is that 17:95 only rebuts feasibility concerns and does not positively define communicative fitness.
structural_cues: 17:93 and 17:94 place بشرًا رسولًا in adjacent, opposed voices; 17:95 answers with a counterfactual matching settled angelic inhabitants to an angelic messenger.

activation_trace.role: Available direction remains the object whose evidentiary sufficiency the challengers contest.
Taking charge until sufficiency is achieved supplies the answer to endlessly extended proof demands.
Testimony that states what is known establishes an authorized account between the parties.
Knowledge of report and inward reality reaches the motive beneath the spoken objection.
Insight of the heart extends the witness beyond the visible spectacles demanded by the objectors.

changed_reading.after: The people claim authority to define adequacy, while the sequence relocates sufficiency in a witness who knows both their utterance and its inward posture.
changed_reading.before: The people lack the kind of evidence they consider adequate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close answers escalating demands with a sufficient witness who knows the inward condition and sees the outward act. The focus objection therefore also becomes a jurisdictional dispute over who sets the proof standard: the challengers prescribe spectacle, while the close locates sufficiency in comprehensive divine witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies escalating human proof demands and a closing sufficient witness with inward and outward knowledge; I infer a contest over evidentiary authority. The live alternative is that the closing witness concerns accountability only, not the standard for recognizing guidance.
structural_cues: 17:96 closes the demand-objection sequence with God as sufficient witness, knowing and seeing the servants.

remaining_uncertainties: The awakening force of ب ع ث may be secondary to its straightforward commissioning sense.
The receiver-configuration model does not settle whether posture causes refusal or summarizes it.
The demolition and hydraulic readings are branch-led analogies and should not be promoted to lexical meanings.
strongest_changes: The people's قول is not merely an explanation of unbelief; repeated until-conditions show speech actively manufacturing the barrier.
The exact بشرًا رسولًا revoicing and 17:95 counterfactual reverse humanity from disqualification into recipient-matched accessibility.
The arrival pattern and differential-reception sequence make guidance an order-displacing input whose effect depends on the recipient's formed posture.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's adjacent phrase reversal, repeated ب ع ث and ج ي ء roots, and explicit angel-population counterfactual produced unusually inspectable changes; the split ه د ي mapping also preserved a contained threat/demolition outlier.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and demolition supply an exploratory image for how arrived guidance may be experienced by an invested false order.
Threat and intimidation supply the defensive affect that can convert guidance into an occasion for objection.
Vanishing until no trace remains gives the form-distant demolition image a nearby functional correlate.
Loss of stability identifies what would experience guidance's arrival as destructive pressure.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance is felt by an invested false arrangement as demolition or threat, and the objection voices that defensive experience.
changed_reading.before: Guidance is benign direction that the people inexplicably decline.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ه د د mapping for focus ه د ي, which is form-distant from the ordinary guidance sense. It remains anchored at the focus word and gains contextual traction from 17:81's disappearance of falsehood. Render it only as a possible felt effect of guidance on a threatened order, never as the lexical gloss of الهدى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet gives focus ه د ي at word 8 both its ordinary target and a secondary ه د د target; the nearby arrival sequence removes unstable falsehood.

activation_trace.role: A depression where water gathers supplies the exploratory hydraulic image inside the focus arrival root.
Guidance as a delivered gift supplies the semantic arrival that the challengers replace with a material flow they prescribe.
Water springing from its source supplies the first demanded, controllable form of arrival.
Wide splitting and outburst intensify the requested conversion of proof into visible flow.
A river cleaving earth with running water completes the challengers' preferred delivery medium.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they substitute a specifiable hydraulic arrival for the semantic gift already delivered through a human, preferring proof they can script and watch flow.
changed_reading.before: The people ask for material signs in addition to guidance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it activates the water-collection branch of focus ج ي ء rather than treating it as the verb's direct sense. It remains anchored in جاءهم الهدى and in the immediately preceding demands for a spring and coursing rivers. Render it as an analogy for substituted proof media, not as a claim that guidance literally means water.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Guidance comes at focus word 7, after the challengers specify that water must spring from earth and rivers must be made to course before they will believe.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The messenger's visible humanity becomes the barrier to receiving directional arrival.** `م ن ع:B002` barrier, `ج ي ء:B001` arrival, `ه د ي:B001/B002` gentle direction, `ب ع ث:B002` dispatch, `ب ش ر:B001/B002` visible skin/human, and `ر س ل:B002` messenger. Guidance arrives, but its embodied carrier is recoded as disqualifying. I infer expectation of nonhuman mediation blocks the accessible form chosen for communication. Humanity reads as the delivery interface they mistake for contradiction.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:107 shows knowledgeable prior recipients responding bodily to a humanly recited message. This later reception demonstrates the fitness of embodied mediation rather than merely asserting it.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Visible humanity becomes the barrier to receiving guidance.** Lexical evidence: `م ن ع B002` (a barrier between a person and what he seeks) in `مَنَعَ`, `ء م ن B002` (trusting assent) in `يُؤْمِنُوا۟`, `ب ع ث B002` (dispatching and directing someone) in `أَبَعَثَ`, `ب ش ر B002` (human as visibly skinned being) in `بَشَرًا`, and `ر س ل B002` (messenger and message) in `رَّسُولًا`. Structural cue: 17:93 answers spectacle-demands by naming the human messenger; this ayah identifies that category as the objection, while 17:95 tests the counterfactual ecology of an angel population. Assigned role: dispatch supplies authorized movement, but visible skin is misread as incompatible with message-bearing and blocks assent. Abductive move: guidance has already arrived; I infer that the barrier is a prior theory about what a carrier should be, not absence of content. Reading change: disbelief becomes a medium-category error that rejects a message because its envoy shares the receivers' embodiment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:95's angelic-earth counterfactual was decisive: messenger kind follows the receivers' settled ecology, dissolving the claim that visible humanity disqualifies transmission.

words.gloss_range: resumptive and coordinating link that carries the prior exchange into a new diagnostic sentence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps 17:94 attached to the previous human-messenger exchange instead of opening a detached topic. Its link reaches directly into the negated restriction that follows, so the same phrase accepted as prophetic self-description in 17:93 is carried forward and re-heard as the objectors' barrier in 17:94.

topics.headline: resumptive link to the prior exchange
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah continues the prior human-messenger exchange rather than beginning a new subject.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction coordinates and resumes the prior exchange, and the boundary evidence ties 17:94 to the answer in 17:93.

topics.headline: connector fused to the negation frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the boundary link and the negated diagnosis arrive together, making continuity and restriction part of one launch.
topics.reason: The particle is immediately followed by the negative element that opens the exclusive-cause construction.

topics.headline: same phrase returns with changed speaker stance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same human-messenger wording move from accepted self-description in 17:93 to incredulous objection in 17:94.
topics.reason: The boundary rows identify an exact phrase reprise across 17:93 and 17:94 with a reversal in speaker stance.

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening an exclusive-cause frame that clears other preventers before the exception
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the first half of the restriction frame: it negates any preventing cause until the later exception names the sole cause. The surrounding frame selects negative-particle force rather than question or relative parsing. The particle is light in form, but it controls the ayah's diagnostic architecture by making the objection not one factor among others but the only stated barrier. The same prevention-and-exception pattern recalls the explanation of withheld signs (17:59), now turned toward withheld belief.

topics.headline: negative particle opening exclusive scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first clears away all rival causes before exposing one barrier.
topics.reason: Local syntax identifies a negated exception construction completed by the later exception particle.

topics.headline: possible parses narrowed to negative particle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids treating the word as a vague question or relative marker and sees it driving the prevention verb.
topics.reason: The following verb and later exception select negative-particle function, so broader possible functions of the form do not govern this occurrence.

topics.headline: sole cause delayed until the pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the sentence withhold the answer until the exception, creating a guided discovery of the real obstacle.
topics.reason: The negative particle begins the frame, while the cause is postponed until the exception clause.

topics.headline: prevention pattern recalls 17:59
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same type of restriction used for withheld signs in 17:59 is reused here for withheld belief.
topics.reason: The source rows give a concrete same-surah structural parallel with 17:59.

words.gloss_range: completed prevention or obstruction that blocks the people from entering faith, with the cause disclosed later as their own saying
words.prose: {{ar:مَنَعَ}} ({{tr:manaʿa}}) makes refusal a completed obstruction, not a neutral lack of belief. Its argument frame names the people and the blocked act, then waits for the exception clause to reveal the preventer as their own saying. The root's barrier and fortress pressure makes that saying feel like a wall they build against guidance, while the same-surah recurrence with 17:59 shifts the prevention theme from withheld signs to self-blocked faith. The simple Form I and tight final closure keep the obstruction stark rather than morphologically amplified.
words.root_gloss_range: blocking, restraining, withholding, and defensive protection; locally the barrier sense is selected, with defensive-wall imagery as pressure

topics.headline: completed prevention with blocked action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees disbelief as an accomplished obstruction of a named action, not as simple absence.
topics.reason: The perfect verb governs the people and the clausal complement for believing.

topics.headline: active verb waits for the real preventer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the syntax as a discovery: the preventer is not named until their saying appears.
topics.reason: The active verb requires a cause, and the exception clause supplies the delayed subject-like cause.

topics.headline: barrier and defensive-wall pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the objection as a self-made barrier against guidance, while local grammar keeps ordinary prevention as the selected sense.
topics.reason: Lexical evidence supports blocking and defensive withholding imagery, but the local verb remains a prevention predicate rather than an independent fortress noun.

topics.headline: bare Form I makes the barrier stark
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no intensified morphology is needed; the obstruction is direct and syntactically exposed.
topics.reason: The local form is a simple Form I perfect verb.

topics.headline: same-surah prevention thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 17:94 answer 17:59 by moving from divine withholding of signs to human self-obstruction.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah recurrence in 17:59 and related prevention scenes.

topics.headline: audible closure fits obstruction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can notice a small sound-form reinforcement: the verb closes tightly as its meaning blocks access.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is local to the surface form and supports, rather than replaces, the semantic topic.

words.gloss_range: the definite human collective as the affected object of prevention, later revealed as responsible through speech
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسَ}} ({{tr:al-nāsa}}) makes the affected party a definite human collective, not a private dissenter. The ayah first places them as the object acted on by prevention, then reveals their own speech as the cause, so the blocked group becomes responsible for its barrier. The social-visible human field sharpens the irony: humans object to the very human embodiment through which the messenger comes. As part of Surah 17's public-response thread, the word also lets the nasal sound binding keep the blocked group tightly attached to the prevention phrase.
words.root_gloss_range: human social visibility, familiarity, and contested links with forgetfulness; locally the social-visible human collective is foregrounded

topics.headline: definite collective object of prevention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the refusal as a collective human pattern rather than a single person's doubt.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and accusative as the direct object of the prevention verb.

topics.headline: patients become the cause through speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are first blocked, then exposed as the ones who made the block.
topics.reason: The same group is object of prevention and later carried by plural speech morphology.

topics.headline: visible humans object to human embodiment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the irony that social-visible humans reject a messenger on the ground of visible humanity.
topics.reason: The lexical pressure is relevant because the local objection turns on human embodiment, though the local noun simply denotes the people.

topics.headline: collective form resists individualizing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a social response to guidance, not merely an isolated private failure.
topics.reason: The definite collective noun keeps the scope broad.

topics.headline: same-surah public response thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place the word inside Surah 17's wider public-response pattern around signs, speech, and guidance.
topics.reason: The contextual rows tie the noun to the surah's public messenger discourse.

topics.headline: nasal sounds bind object to prevention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can notice a local sound binding between the prevention verb and its human object.
topics.reason: The sound observation is surface-local and reinforces the grammar.

words.gloss_range: subordinating and nominalizing particle that turns believing into the blocked object of prevention
words.prose: The first {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) turns the following believing-clause into the thing prevented. It is structurally small but decisive: it binds the following subjunctive verb into a dependent unit, so faith is not a separate assertion but the unreached destination after the people are named. Its contrast with the later matching particle matters because the ayah sets nominalized believing against nominalized saying.

topics.headline: believing made into the blocked object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees belief treated grammatically as the destination from which the people were held back.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the clausal complement governed by the prevention verb.

topics.headline: particle governs the dependent verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the believing action is grammatically dependent and unrealized inside the prevention frame.
topics.reason: QAC marks the following verb as subjunctive after this particle.

topics.headline: two matching particles produce opposite acts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that identical particle shape helps balance blocked believing against blocking saying.
topics.reason: The first particle governs a subjunctive imperfect, while the later particle nominalizes a completed speech-act.

topics.headline: second beat names the unreached goal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the syntax move from the people to the action they failed to reach.
topics.reason: The complement follows the direct object and supplies the blocked action.

words.gloss_range: objectless Form IV believing as entry into faith, trust, or security, dependent and unrealized inside the prevention frame
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْمِنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:yuʾminū}}) is objectless and subjunctive, so the blocked act is not assent to one named proposition but entry into faith and trust itself. The root's security field makes the prevention feel like being kept outside a zone of safety after guidance has arrived. Its imperfect form keeps the action unrealized, while the plural ending carries the people into the very action their saying prevents; a small nasal thread also binds prevention and faith in sound. The same passage already voiced refusal to believe in 17:90, and this word diagnoses that refusal.
words.root_gloss_range: security, safety, trust, faith, and entrusted reliability; locally the objectless Form IV selects entering faith or trust as a state

topics.headline: objectless faith as a state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the blocked act as entering faith itself, not merely believing a specified proposition.
topics.reason: The local verb lacks an explicit prepositional or nominal object.

topics.headline: subjunctive imperfect marks unrealized action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices faith as the action that should have followed guidance but remains suspended in dependency.
topics.reason: The verb is an imperfect subjunctive after the nominalizing particle.

topics.headline: faith as entry into security and trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels belief as entering safety and trust, while local grammar keeps faith-state as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root field supports security and trust pressure, but the local objectless Form IV remains the governing reading.

topics.headline: plural ending carries the people forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earlier human collective still visible in the plural morphology of the blocked act.
topics.reason: The verb carries third-person masculine plural agreement without repeating the subject lexically.

topics.headline: speech and faith set in causal opposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees their saying as causally opposed to the faith they should have entered.
topics.reason: The local construction explicitly makes the later saying prevent this believing.

topics.headline: 17:90 refusal is diagnosed here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the explicit refusal to believe in 17:90 with the diagnosis of what prevented belief in 17:94.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-passage references around 17:90 and 17:94.

topics.headline: nasal sound links prevention and faith
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a small sound link between the obstruction and the faith it blocks.
topics.reason: The phonetic note is local and reinforces the semantic relation.

words.gloss_range: temporal particle with causal force, inserting the arrival of guidance as the circumstance that removes excuse
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) inserts the timing that makes the refusal culpable: the prevention occurred when guidance had already come to them. Its temporal force can carry causal weight here, because the arrival of guidance is precisely why the objection cannot be explained as lack of evidence. The particle hinges the guidance-arrival clause between blocked faith and the later exception that exposes the cause. It also points back across the boundary, treating the previous response in 17:93 as the guidance-arrival moment now being resisted.

topics.headline: guidance had already arrived
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that refusal follows evidence rather than preceding it.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the temporal guidance-arrival clause inside the prevention frame.

topics.headline: temporal force also supports cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the timing also functions as an argument against the objectors.
topics.reason: Local syntax licenses a temporal reading, and the context lets that timing carry causal force without replacing the temporal function.

topics.headline: short particle hinges into arrival clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the guidance-arrival clause inserted between blocked faith and the exception that exposes the cause.
topics.reason: The particle depends on the following arrival verb and functions as a hinge inside the larger restriction.

topics.headline: points back to the prior answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can identify the prior response in 17:93 as part of the guidance now being rejected.
topics.reason: The boundary row ties the temporal frame to the preceding ayah.

words.gloss_range: completed arrival that reaches the people directly, with guidance as the arriving subject
words.prose: {{ar:جَآءَهُمُ}} ({{tr:jāʾahumu}}) says guidance reached them directly; it was not merely available somewhere else. The perfect form makes the arrival complete before the objection, and the attached pronoun names the people as the reached recipients. The simple arrival form lets guidance act as the arriving subject rather than emphasizing an external bringer, and the long-vowel-to-hamza landing makes the arrival feel audible.
